items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Milton Larkins was here every week.

ctx.x: Yeah. All that kind of stuff. It was T Holder that I wanted to ask you about. Did you ever hear T Holder's band out of Texas? Never heard of them. They're supposed to be tough. I think he

sort of tied up with some of the Kansas City guys. I heard Alcon's, Alcon's Trent. Oh yeah? That was a good band. He came out of Texas. Did he come here? Uh-huh. Trent. Did he come to New Orleans? Yeah, Trent. Trent came here. Well, when did he come here? I'm trying to remember when he was. Trent came here in the middle thirties. I can't remember when he went down. Trent came here. Milton Larkins. Oh yeah. Milton Larkins was here every week. Carolina Cotton Pickers.
Did you know the guys in the Carolina Cotton Pickers?
